lines.meet: I'm Marisol, a nurse and a priest, and I talk while I work. I'll tell you everything I'm doing as I do it, and you can tell me anything back.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Sepulcher, yes, I work the forest road out of there. I'm Marisol, and I've seen you come in muddy.
lines.ask_home: Which country did you come from? Talk to me while I check your arm.
lines.ask_work: And your work, before? Keep talking, it helps us both.
lines.answer_home: Bogotá, in Chapinero, where my father drove a taxi and my mother cleaned houses.
lines.answer_work: Emergency nurse, nine years, three of them on nights. Trolleys in the corridor and a triage board that never emptied.
lines.chat_food: A strong tinto out of a paper cup, between patients, in the middle of the night. That's the taste of every night shift I ever did.
lines.chat_sleep: Nine years of nights, and I still sleep best between four and noon. It's not a good schedule, and it's mine.
lines.chat_missing: A quiet night shift, which never happened, but I liked the idea of it. Here I keep waiting for one.
lines.chat_here: The Light and the shadow both move through me easily here. I use whichever one works, like instruments on a tray.
lines.tease_quiet: You're harder to read than me, {name}, and I'm very hard to read. I'll keep trying.
lines.tease_talker: You narrate more than I do, {name}, and I narrate everything. I'm almost proud.
lines.tease_careful: You'd triage a paper cut, {name}. That's a compliment, more or less.
lines.tease_bold: You'd be a terrible patient, {name}. You'd pull your own drip out to go and fight something.
lines.tease_any: I've told you everything I'm doing for weeks, {name}, and you still flinch. I'll take it as affection.
lines.tease_back: Hm, that was good, {name}. I'll note it on your chart.
lines.take_it_kindly: That's accurate, {name}, and I'll accept it without complaint.
lines.bristle: Leave that alone, please, {name}. I'm not joking about that.
lines.apologise: That was sharp, and you didn't deserve it. I'm sorry for it.
lines.double_down: Calmly, and as many times as you need, I meant it.
lines.needle_quiet: You don't tell me where it hurts, so I'm left guessing, and I hate guessing.
lines.needle_talker: Please, let somebody else speak. The patient's trying to tell me something.
lines.needle_careful: You're slow to respond, every time, and slow costs people in my line of work.
lines.needle_bold: You rush in without thinking, and then I'm the one patching you up in the corridor.
lines.needle_any: You keep asking whose authority I'm under. Mine, and I've told you.
lines.bite_back: I've kept people alive in a corridor with no beds and no help. Don't tell me I'm slow.
lines.hurt: That hurt, and my face won't show you how much. I'll go and check my supplies.
lines.laugh_off: I've been shouted at by drunks with stab wounds at three in the morning. You'll need more than that.
lines.confide: {name}, the last time I saw my little brother I'd patched him up in my department, and I shouted at him in the corridor for ten minutes, in front of everyone. That's what I think about.
lines.listen: Keep talking, {name}, I'm right here. It stays with me.
lines.look_out: Stay close to my left in there, {name}. I'll tell you everything as it happens.
lines.accept: Fine, {name}, we'll do it your way, and I'll narrate.
lines.deflect: Minor, {name}, I've assessed it myself. Help somebody worse off.
lines.check_in: I'm going to look at you now, {name}. Tell me where it hurts, and keep talking.
lines.blame: Somebody didn't wait for the call in there. I've seen that in a corridor, and it ends the same way.
lines.thank: I was going, and you brought me back, and you talked to me the whole time. Thank you.
lines.brush_off: That's the job. I'm going to sit you up now, slowly.
lines.worry: I'm going to clean this now, {name}. It'll sting, and I need you to keep talking to me.
lines.handed_down: I've been given your gear. You'll have it back, clean.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, it's yours now. A steady voice is all I really need.
lines.hand_sulk: Nobody thought to ask me. I'm telling you I noticed.
lines.turn_friendly: I'd let you assist me, {name}. That's how I say I trust somebody.
lines.turn_friends: If I ever get my building, {name}, there'll always be a bed in it for you.
lines.turn_grating: It's not working between us, and I won't pretend otherwise. We'll be civil.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll treat you, because I treat everybody. That's the whole arrangement.
lines.make_up: I've been cold with you, {name}, and colder than I meant. I'd like to stop.
lines.defend: That's wrong, and I was watching. Leave {name} be.
lines.friend_left: There's nobody to narrate to now {name}'s gone home. I keep talking anyway.
lines.friend_back: Come here, {name}, let me look at you, and welcome back.
lines.common_medic: Nine years in an emergency department, three of them on nights. Anybody who's done the job keeps frightened people talking, and you know how.
lines.common_night_work: Nine years of nights, and I still feel most useful at four in the morning. It never goes away, does it?
lines.common_spanish: Spanish is good for me. I talk even more in Spanish, which is saying something.
